items: Shows a clear “That block is no longer available” message when a block or placement has become stale, and clears outdated editing state.
Prevents pages from getting stuck when block information is requested after the block has been removed.
Improves page-tree move choices by excluding descendants and other invalid parent locations.
Makes page-tree navigation and editing behavior more consistent across the app.
Provides clearer fallback logging when a page tree cannot be prepared.
